meta.title: Crossback trading rules v1.6
meta.r_definition: 1R is the distance from the buy to the initial stop.

input.slippage_note: Assumption: 0.03% of price on the buy and again on the sell. Change it and every figure recalculates.
input.risk_per_trade_label: Risk per trade (a full stop-out loses this share of the account)

caveats: The result rests on a few large runners. HOOD (+59R, bought 2025-05-19) and MARA (+43R, bought 2023-11-27) are 32% of the total.
Many months have no trades (QQQ under its 10 EMA) or lose. Expect long flat stretches between runners.
The rules were chosen by comparing many variants on this same three-year period, so the figures are optimistic.
Held days use daily bars: a day that trades both the stop and a higher price is counted as stopped.
Not modelled: the 15:45 sell time (the backtest sells at the close), commissions, buying power, names added mid-session. The universe is today's list, so delisted names are missing.

Source: Alpaca 15-minute and daily bars, the scanner daily scan as of each previous close, Yahoo Finance earnings dates; backend/research/crossback_runner.py run 2026-11-16 with KEEP_UP=1 KEEP_DOWN=0 RISK_ATR_MAX=0.25 REGIME=1 REGIME_PRIOR=1 INV_NONE=1 QQQ_COND=close10 LEADER=1 LEADER_ATR=5 LEADER_RISK_ATR=0.35 MIN_ADV=300e6 MIN_ATR=3 SETUP_ONLY=s_ema-crossback,s_mur20 RAISE_AFTER=5 FILTER='rs_intraday > 0 and (ext_s50 > 0 or leader)' (row: extension cap off, at most 3 new trades a day).
risk_table_source: Source: backend/research/crossback_sizing.py on the same run. The account rows above (and the Trades tab) compound trade by trade in order of entry instead, so they differ a little.
risk_table_intro: $100k start, every trade above, positions overlapping as they did (sized at entry). The reshuffled columns replay the same trades in 2,000 random orders: plan for the 1-in-20 drawdown, not the one history happened to give.

rules_meta.title: Crossback trading rules v1.6
rules_meta.blurb: Version 1.6, 2026-11-16. The rules as the app runs them. Tested over November 2023 to November 2026; results are on the other tabs. Every rule change gets the next version number (Version history tab).

Trend Leaders: the same limit

QQQ's 15:45 price is above its daily 10 EMA (counting that price as today's close): keep the whole position

The stock is stronger than QQQ since the open: its % move from today's open to the buy price minus QQQ's % move from its open to the trigger candle's close is above this many points; otherwise skip
At each day's 15:45 check (the entry day's included), raise the stop to 1 cent under the lowest daily low of the last N days, today included; it only moves up
A gap under the stop sells at the open
Sell at the 15:45 check before an earnings report
A name with an open position takes no new trade
At most this many new trades a day, earliest fills first (higher daily scan score first within the same candle); later fills and waiting alerts are cancelled
Long trades only: no short side
The watchlist is system-only: only the alerts add and remove names; you cannot add, remove or star names

rules_notes: The backtest matches the app except: sells are at the 4:00 close instead of 15:45, and the 150-name cap is not applied.

The two pattern setups and the stronger-than-QQQ rule were chosen after comparing many variants on this same period, so the total is optimistic; the rule's case rests on every half-year being positive.
Risk per trade is not a rule of the app; the account columns use the risk on the Results tab.
Risk per trade on the Results and Trades tabs: 0.20% of the account, compounding trade by trade in order of entry; with several positions open at once the real path differs a little.

version_history.What changed: First documented version: the rules the app runs after pull requests 111, 112 and 113.

Short side removed from the rules and the app (it was never backtested): no inverse-ETF trades, no short names on the watchlist, short settings off the Alerts page. Long rules and the backtest unchanged.
Names you add to the watchlist yourself are written in as the one exception: the app alerts them (long, same entry and exits) although the backtest does not cover them. App and backtest unchanged.

The watchlist is system-only for now: only the alerts add and remove names. Adding, removing and moving names back from Positions are switched off, names added by hand are no longer alerted and are cleared at the next post-close reset. The 1.2 exception is gone: every traded name is covered by the backtest. Backtest unchanged.

At most 3 new trades a day (earliest fills first, higher daily scan score first within a candle); a later fill or a waiting alert past the cap is cancelled before it is announced. Backtest: +372.1R against +329.3R with no cap.

Take a long only when the stock is stronger than QQQ since the open: its move from today's open to the buy price minus QQQ's move from its open to the trigger candle's close must be above 0 points. Backtest: +319.8R with a 25.4R drawdown and every half-year positive, against +372.1R, 44.3R and three losing half-years for 1.4.

Pattern-setup names need the buy above the prior-day 50-day average, and names under it are left off the watchlist (Trend Leaders already meet it). Backtest unchanged in practice: +319.8R, 25.4R drawdown (8 trades dropped, -1.5R between them); the watchlist is shorter.
